title: SEC4: cmd_contacts_list has no doc comment
description:
Function cmd_contacts_list (line 93, main.rs) is public-ish (called from main) but:
- No doc comment explaining its purpose or parameters
- The column layout (LOGIN, DISPLAY NAME, MAILBOX HOST, BLOCKED) is printed but not documented
- The fallback logic (lines 112-116 using tailscale_user_id if login is empty) is not explained

SUGGESTION: Add doc comment above cmd_contacts_list explaining the output format and the fallback behavior for missing fields.
